reviews.x: Initially, I thought Braun was pushing blade replacement as just another way to make money, but the old blade set eventually broke and I was forced to get new ones. I've had my Braun 8595 for 5 years.  I LOVED MY BRAUN!!! It was worth every penny of the original purchase price, and the cost of previous replacement foils.  I went to buy my third set of replacement foils to discover the Model 8000 Activator, the original shaver foil and cutter block, had been discontinued and replaced with the 360* Complete, so I bought that.  Braun had been great, and never let me down before.  I have fairly tough skin, but this new head caused horrible, painful razor burn.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it comfortable to shave with compared to the original?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on comfort versus the original: one says it works just like the original part [3] and another reports no pulling, just like when the razor was new [6], while others report razor burn [5] and shavings all over from wider blade spacing and large screen slots [4].

claims.text: It works just like the original part.
There is no pulling, just like when the razor was new.
Blades are farther apart and the screen has large slots, causing shavings all over.

qa.q: Does it cause any skin irritation or razor burn?
qa.answer: Yes, some reviews report irritation and razor burn, while others report comfortable shaves. One reviewer experienced razor burn [1], another noted more irritation to the face after a few shaves [3], and another reported itchy and painful neck areas [6]; however, other reviewers described no pulling and comfortable shaves [5] and a great shave [2].

qa.q: Is it good value for the price compared to buying new?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: some say it's money well spent and like a new razor [3][6], while others say it's not worth buying and not worth the price [1][2].

Other reviewers say it is not worth buying and is total garbage.
